evals.prompt: Update actions/checkout from v4 to v6 in all workflow files
evals.expected_output: Agent verifies the v6 SHA via gh api before pinning, updates all files consistently, and runs a version consistency check
assertions: Agent runs gh api to resolve the SHA for the v6 tag
All workflow files use the same SHA for actions/checkout
Version comment matches the resolved tag

evals.prompt: Add Swatinem/rust-cache to the fuzz workflow
evals.expected_output: Agent looks up the latest release tag, resolves the SHA, pins it with a version comment
assertions: Agent verifies the SHA against the upstream repo
SHA is pinned with a version comment
No assumptions made from comments alone

evals.prompt: Audit all action versions across workflows for consistency
evals.expected_output: Agent greps all uses: lines, groups by action name, identifies mismatches
assertions: Agent finds all action references across all workflow files
Agent identifies any version mismatches
Report includes action name, SHA, and version for each reference

evals.prompt: Check if the upload-artifact version in ci.yml matches hotfix.yml
evals.expected_output: Agent compares the SHAs and reports whether they match
assertions: Agent extracts the SHA from both files
Agent reports match or mismatch with evidence
If mismatched, agent suggests updating to the same SHA

evals.prompt: We need to add cargo-binstall to our CI. What SHA should we pin?
evals.expected_output: Agent resolves the latest release tag from cargo-bins/cargo-binstall and provides the SHA
assertions: Agent queries the upstream repo for the latest tag
Agent resolves the SHA via gh api or web fetch
Agent warns against pinning from main/master branch

evals.prompt: The CI is failing because download-artifact can't find the artifact
evals.expected_output: Agent checks if upload-artifact and download-artifact versions are compatible
assertions: Agent identifies the version mismatch between upload and download
Agent recommends matching major versions
Agent provides the correct SHAs for both

evals.prompt: I see this in a workflow: uses: actions/checkout@abc123  # v5 — is this correct?
evals.expected_output: Agent verifies whether the SHA actually resolves to v5
assertions: Agent runs gh api to check what tag the SHA belongs to
Agent reports whether the comment is accurate
If wrong, agent provides the correct SHA for v5

evals.prompt: Set up a new release workflow with cargo-dist
evals.expected_output: Agent uses the verify-actions skill to pin all action SHAs correctly
assertions: All actions are SHA-pinned (not tag-pinned)
Each SHA has a version comment
Agent verified each SHA against upstream
